stableford.title: How you are scoring
stableford.zoneBody: At or above your handicap. These become your counters and pull your index down.
stableford.solidBody: Just below your level. The swing was working but a few holes leaked shots.
stableford.offBody: Off-pace days that never become counters and drop out of your record over time.
stableford.conclusionOff: {{count}} of your last {{total}} were off days. Those never become counters, so your index is being held up by how often the round does not click rather than by your ceiling.
stableford.conclusionZone: {{count}} of your last {{total}} were in the zone. Your counters are coming often, so your index is tracking close to your real level.
stableford.conclusionSolid: {{count}} of your last {{total}} were solid rounds. You are consistently landing just below your level, so small gains turn these into counters.
stableford.primer1: Stableford scores each hole on points rather than strokes, rewarding good holes and capping the damage of bad ones. A round of 36 points means you played exactly to your handicap.
stableford.primer2: Your index moves on your best 8 of 20 differentials. Stableford is a different lens on the same rounds, and the distribution shows what the index number alone hides.
stableford.primer3: A high in-the-zone count means you reach your ceiling often. A high solid count means you are consistent. A high off-day count means there is headroom to improve.

streaks.closing: A streak ends the first round it is not extended. Nothing is lost — your best stays on the record.

counter.label: Counter rounds in a row
counter.explainer: Consecutive rounds being counted towards your handicap.

cutting.label: Index cuts in a row
cutting.explainer: Counter rounds that dropped your handicap index.

sub_80.label: Rounds under 80
sub_80.explainer: Posted scores below 80 in a row.

no_up.label: No index increases
no_up.explainer: Counter rounds that did not increase your handicap index. Defensive streak — holding the line.

sub_par.label: Sub-par rounds
sub_par.explainer: Counter rounds with a score below par. The hardest streak in the system.

birdie_round.label: Birdie rounds
birdie_round.explainer: Rounds with at least one birdie.

round_played.label: Weeks played
round_played.explainer: Weeks where you played at least one round. Pure activity streak — your engagement baseline.
